pre_execution_amendment: Named the executable gates G1-G6 exactly, added the pinned upstream environment source required for tagged/reset provenance, and authorized only the CPU contract milestone. No outcome data or team episodes existed when amended.
classification: DIAGNOSTIC / EXTERNAL SCRIPTED-CONTROLLER BASELINE. Not PAPER-FAITHFUL. Not latent-strategy work. Not PPO training.
scientific_question: Can an externally defined attacker/defender controller family preserve its easy-mode semantics in this CTF environment, can those semantics be represented through the project's macro action interface, and does deterministic 2A/2D agent-to-role allocation become payoff-relevant once role behavior is fixed?
scientific_delta: Introduce no learned policy and no reward or environment change. Port the externally defined Pyquaticus BaseAttacker and BaseDefender easy-mode semantics, compare direct native semantic execution with projection through the existing action interface, then vary only the deterministic agent-to-role mapping.
no_resolved_config_diff: No PPOConfig or latent preset is created or modified by this paper-only freeze.

FRAMING_LOCK.existing_project_fact: Explicit attack/defense decomposition is not new to this environment. Existing scripted Blue controllers already produce payoff-relevant strategic differences in 4v4.
FRAMING_LOCK.purpose_of_this_rung: Semantic portability and role-assignment evaluation using an external, pre-existing controller family, independently of PPO.
FRAMING_LOCK.frozen_paper_wording: The failed ROLE experiment did not test explicit behavioral role decomposition. It tested whether a shared PPO policy could exploit an ATTACK/DEFEND conditioning variable. Explicit scripted decomposition has already demonstrated payoff-relevant behavior in our environment. The Pyquaticus experiment provides an externally grounded controller family for testing semantic portability and agent-to-role assignment independently of PPO.
FRAMING_LOCK.forbidden_reading: No result from this rung may be described as PPO learning roles, PPO discovering specialization, or a repair of the shared PPO policy.

stage_2: TRUE_NATIVE: global-state controller semantics execute as direct physical targets with the upstream normalized speed intent
PROJECTED: the same semantic targets are represented through the existing legal macro-plus-target interface
FROZEN_HIERARCHY.stage_3: Within each cleared execution arm, compare the same 2 BaseAttacker plus 2 BaseDefender controllers under CLOSEST_DEFENDS, FARTHEST_DEFENDS, and FIXED_IDENTITY mappings.
FROZEN_HIERARCHY.dependency: No later stage is authorized until every gate of the preceding stage passes and its result artifact is frozen.

UPSTREAM_PROVENANCE_GATE.attribution_requirement: Any adapted source file and research artifact must retain the upstream copyright and BSD-3-Clause attribution.

source_files.purpose: tagged auto-home execution and reset-state provenance
easy-mode geometry defaults: env_bounds=[160,80] m, flag_keepout=3 m, catch_radius=10 m

explicitly_excluded.reason: It combines role definition with upstream role selection. Importing it would confound controller semantics with assignment.

UPSTREAM_PROVENANCE_GATE.gate_pass_condition: Implementation must re-check the pinned commit and every listed SHA256 before adapting code. Any mismatch requires a written provenance amendment before implementation.

INFORMATION_CONTRACT.TRUE_NATIVE: Uses full simulator global state for all friendly carry flags, own/enemy flag positions, own position, heading, tagged state, and alive state. It must not reconstruct those quantities from the agent-local observation.
INFORMATION_CONTRACT.PROJECTED: Receives the exact same global semantic state and computes the exact same semantic target as TRUE_NATIVE. Only target-to-action representation may differ.
INFORMATION_CONTRACT.later_decentralized_variant: Reconstructing controller state from local observations is a separate decentralized-adaptation experiment and is outside this spec.
INFORMATION_CONTRACT.anti_leak_note: Global state is allowed because this is a scripted external-controller diagnostic, not a decentralized learned actor and not a paper-faithful latent-policy row.

BaseAttacker.no_friendly_carrier: Target the current opponent flag position at normalized desired speed 0.5.
BaseAttacker.self_carries: Target own flag home at normalized desired speed 0.5.
BaseAttacker.teammate_carries: Target own flag home at normalized desired speed 0.5, including for every non-carrier attacker.
BaseAttacker.source_condition: self.has_flag OR any teammate has_flag selects home; otherwise opponent flag.

BaseDefender.unit_adapter: Map upstream catch_radius=10 m to this environment's tag_range_cells=2.5. The locked scale is 0.25 cell/m, so the local threshold is 3.5 cells. This preserves the 0.3 keepout/catch and 0.1 buffer/catch ratios.
BaseDefender.outside_threshold: If distance to the current own flag position is strictly greater than 3.5 cells, point toward the current own flag at normalized desired speed 0.5.
BaseDefender.inside_or_on_threshold: If distance is less than or equal to 3.5 cells, point directly away from the current own flag at normalized desired speed 0.5.
BaseDefender.stolen_flag_case: Use current own flag position, not own flag home.

tagged_and_dead.tagged: Controller role remains assigned, but environment-level tagged handling overrides the controller and targets own flag home. This matches the upstream environment's easy-mode execution contract, where tagged players are auto-driven home independently of BaseAttacker/BaseDefender's easy branch.
tagged_and_dead.dead: Pinned Pyquaticus has tagged state but no project-equivalent alive/dead respawn axis. Dead agents are therefore an explicit local interface adaptation: they are immobile and controller output is ignored. This adaptation must be reported separately from copied upstream semantics.
tagged_and_dead.recovery: After untag/respawn, the agent resumes the same episode-static role. No death, tag, untag, or respawn event triggers role reassignment in this first rung.

TRUE_NATIVE.definition: Convert the semantic vector to a direct world-space physical target and execute it through the simulator's native target/dynamics path, bypassing MacroAction and target-index decoding.
TRUE_NATIVE.speed_contract: For alive, untagged agents, cap requested speed at 0.5 times the local maximum speed, matching upstream easy mode's desired_speed_normalized=0.5. Existing collision, obstacle, tagging, flag, and capture rules remain active.
TRUE_NATIVE.toward_target: Use the exact current enemy flag, own flag, or own flag home coordinates named by the semantic controller.
TRUE_NATIVE.away_target: Use the ray from the current own flag through the agent and place its endpoint at the arena boundary, preserving the exact outward bearing. At exact flag-center coincidence, preserve upstream zero-relative-bearing behavior by using the agent's current heading. Recompute every decision tick.
TRUE_NATIVE.not_claimed: TRUE_NATIVE is semantic execution inside this simulator. It is not a claim of reproducing Pyquaticus physics, dynamics, or full trajectory identity.

PROJECTED.definition: Represent each already-computed semantic target through the existing legal (macro, target_index) action interface. The adapter may not inspect rewards, scores, opponent identity, future state, or evaluation outcomes.
PROJECTED.target_quantizer: For GO_TO, choose the Euclidean-nearest legal target waypoint; ties resolve to the smaller target index.

attacker_no_friendly_carrier: GET_FLAG with its legal ignored/default target field
GO_TO(nearest legal waypoint to current enemy flag)
attacker_self_carries: GO_HOME with its legal ignored/default target field
GO_TO(nearest legal waypoint to own flag home)
attacker_teammate_carries_self_does_not: GO_HOME with its legal ignored/default target field
GO_TO(nearest legal waypoint to own flag home)
defender_outside_threshold: GO_TO(nearest legal waypoint to current own flag position)
defender_inside_or_on_threshold: GO_TO(nearest legal waypoint along the TRUE_NATIVE away ray)

PROJECTED.carrier_trap: Self-carriers and non-carriers in the friendly-carrier state are separate cases. Physical target agreement alone is insufficient because GO_HOME and carrying overrides can change commitment, success, and failure behavior.

controlled_cases: G1 ATTACK_NO_CARRIER: no friendly carrier implies exact current enemy-flag target
G2 ATTACK_FRIENDLY_CARRIER: self carrier and teammate-carrier/non-carrier cases both imply exact own-flag-home target for every attacker
G2 GLOBAL_CONTRACT: changing only a teammate's global carry bit changes G1 to G2 even when the tested agent-local observation fixture is held fixed
G3 DEFEND_OUTSIDE: distance strictly greater than 3.5 cells implies inward direction toward the current own flag
G4 DEFEND_INSIDE: distance less than or equal to 3.5 cells implies outward direction; displaced/stolen own flag uses current flag position rather than flag home

G5 RESET_TAG: tagged attacker and defender are auto-driven home at upstream max-speed intent; reset clears tagged/carry state; project-local dead agents remain immobile and are reported as a local adaptation
NATIVE_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT_GATE.geometric_coverage: Run each non-degenerate direction case in all four arena quadrants and at headings 0, pi/2, pi, and 3pi/2 where physically valid.
hard_checks: semantic target category is correct in 100% of fixtures
desired-bearing cosine with the analytical semantic vector is at least 0.999999
requested alive/untagged speed equals 0.5 times local max speed within float tolerance
tagged and dead overrides are role-invariant
no local-observation reconstruction path is called
NATIVE_SEMANTIC_CONTRACT_GATE.pass_rule: All hard checks pass. Any failure blocks PROJECTED implementation and team evaluation.

PROJECTION_CONTRACT_GATE.comparison: For the same controlled initial global state, compare each candidate's effective target and physical trajectory against TRUE_NATIVE. No score, win rate, episode return, policy advantage, or opponent-outcome quantity may enter selection.
recorded_metrics: sign and magnitude of radial progress toward or away from the semantic target
paired 16-tick position RMSE relative to TRUE_NATIVE
macro commitment duration and retarget delay
macro success, timeout, and failed-commit events
carrier and non-carrier results reported separately
hard_pass_conditions: correct target category in 100% of fixtures
first-tick desired-bearing cosine at least 0.99 for every nonzero semantic vector
radial-progress sign agrees with TRUE_NATIVE on every alive, untagged, unobstructed tick
maximum effective-target error is at most one local interaction radius (2.5 cells) in every controlled fixture
paired 16-tick position RMSE is at most one local interaction radius (2.5 cells); larger divergence is material because it can change tag/contact outcomes
no structurally impossible macro-success predicate for the semantic branch; ordinary en-route timeout behavior is measured but is not confused with the non-carrier GO_HOME impossibility
friendly-carrier non-carrier case passes independently of the self-carrier case
PROJECTION_CONTRACT_GATE.selection_rule: Discard every candidate that fails a hard condition. Among remaining candidates for a semantic branch, select lexicographically by lower maximum target error, lower 16-tick position RMSE, lower maximum retarget delay, then smaller (macro_id,target_id). Freeze the selected branch mapping and hashes in PYQUATICUS_BEHAVIORAL_ROLE_PROJECTION_ADAPTER_FREEZE.json before any team outcome evaluation.
PROJECTION_CONTRACT_GATE.unrepresentable_rule: If no candidate passes for any required semantic branch, mark PROJECTED UNREPRESENTABLE, report the failed branch, and do not launch PROJECTED team evaluation.
PROJECTION_CONTRACT_GATE.anti_selection_bias: Adapter candidates, metrics, tolerances, and tie-breaking are frozen here. Performance against opponents may not choose, reject, or revise an adapter.

ASSIGNMENT_CONTRACT.role_count: Exactly 2 ATTACK and 2 DEFEND identities on the four-agent controlled roster.
ASSIGNMENT_CONTRACT.assignment_time: Compute once from the reset state before the first action, then hold for the entire episode.
ASSIGNMENT_CONTRACT.reassignment: None within an episode. Death, tag, untag, and respawn do not reassign roles.
ASSIGNMENT_CONTRACT.episode_reset: Recompute at every episode reset using that episode's initial global state.
ASSIGNMENT_CONTRACT.distance: Euclidean distance from each controlled agent's reset position to its own flag home.

arms.CLOSEST_DEFENDS: The two smallest (distance, agent_index) tuples are DEFEND; the remaining two are ATTACK.
arms.FARTHEST_DEFENDS: The two smallest (-distance, agent_index) tuples are DEFEND; the remaining two are ATTACK.
arms.FIXED_IDENTITY: Agent indices 0 and 1 are DEFEND; indices 2 and 3 are ATTACK. Positions do not affect this arm.

ASSIGNMENT_CONTRACT.tie_break: Smaller agent index wins every exact distance tie in both geometric arms.
mapping_checks: identical reset state always yields identical assignment
agent-batch permutation followed by restoration of stable agent ids does not change assignment
synthetic fixtures independently establish the expected CLOSEST_DEFENDS, FARTHEST_DEFENDS, and FIXED_IDENTITY mappings

real evaluation seed block must report pairwise mapping equality rates before outcomes; if every mapping pair is identical on every seed, the assignment comparison is non-informative and outcome evaluation stops

held_identical_across_assignment_arms: pinned BaseAttacker and BaseDefender semantic implementation and hashes
execution arm: compare mappings within TRUE_NATIVE or within the one frozen PROJECTED adapter, never across mixed interfaces
ISOLATION_GATE.cross_execution_note: TRUE_NATIVE versus PROJECTED is a separate interface contrast, not an assignment contrast.

TEAM_EVALUATION_FUTURE_CONTRACT.design_shape_if_unblocked: Six paired cells: 2 execution arms x 3 assignment mappings, with identical seeds within every comparison.
TEAM_EVALUATION_FUTURE_CONTRACT.primary_assignment_question: Within a fixed cleared execution arm, do CLOSEST_DEFENDS, FARTHEST_DEFENDS, or FIXED_IDENTITY produce different payoff distributions when f_A and f_D are held fixed?
TEAM_EVALUATION_FUTURE_CONTRACT.secondary_interface_question: For a fixed assignment mapping, how much does the frozen action projection change behavior and payoff relative to TRUE_NATIVE?
TEAM_EVALUATION_FUTURE_CONTRACT.required_later_freeze: Before any team episode runs, write PYQUATICUS_BEHAVIORAL_ROLE_EVAL_SPEC.json with exact map, rules profile, opponent, seeds, sample size, estimands, bootstrap unit, multiplicity handling, success/failure criteria, runtime command, and artifact paths.
